functions.name: Open the native experiment
functions.behaviour: Starts the G1 Grip-review or G2 graphical workspace, connects to the local engine and enables input only after complete native mapping and coherent state/context adoption.
entry_points: window Magic 600 Cell · G1 native experiment · post-approval development
window Magic 600 Cell · G2 native experiment · post-approval development
functions.engine_call: POST native/handshake; GET native/map; GET structure; GET experiment/native-snapshot
functions.notes: Key entries under native default map identify bindings defined here. Effective banks can remove defaults or override them; ExperimentShell.InputState merges bank and saved bindings. Bindings defined in other shards are dependencies, not additional entry points here. All evidence is source; no Windows execution is claimed.

functions.behaviour: Selects the explicit working orbit by mathematical description or exact ID.

menu Hub object actions: Use as Target

button Hub Next trace: At / After position link

functions.name: Dismiss Hub object actions

button Next is an identity bookmark, not mechanical protection: Activate selected entry

functions.name: Pin or replace locked Next

button Replace locked Next: Replace explicitly

functions.name: Clear locked Next

functions.name: Activate locked Next
functions.behaviour: Explicitly activates the locked Next identity as work focus.

functions.name: Locate locked Next
functions.behaviour: Inspects Next and recenters the native camera on its first current hosting cell without changing Current.

functions.behaviour: Removes the inspected identity's requirement from the intended block.

functions.name: Protect exact labels at a position
functions.behaviour: Captures exact-label protection for the acknowledged inspected fixed position.

functions.behaviour: Preserves the inspected occupant at the fixed position while allowing orientation changes.

functions.name: Release position-only protection

functions.name: Release exact-label protection
functions.behaviour: Removes only exact-label protection at the inspected position.

functions.name: Release all protection at a position
functions.behaviour: Explicitly removes protection at the inspected fixed position.

functions.name: Choose protected orbits

button Solve Protection: Check each turn (checkbox)

functions.name: Choose a work goal

functions.name: Capture the target arrangement

functions.name: Require the Home target arrangement
functions.behaviour: Requests Current's exact Home labels at its Home target.

functions.name: Transform desired block requirements

button Solve operation footer: Reuse steps

button Solve operation footer: Prepare / Macro / Cleanup step lane

functions.name: Edit and save ordered phase steps

functions.notes: The local editing buffer is not the engine draft until saved.

functions.name: Remove or reorder steps in the step editor

entry_points: button Prepare / Macro / Cleanup steps: Remove
button Prepare / Macro / Cleanup steps: Up
button Prepare / Macro / Cleanup steps: Down

functions.name: Choose draft or live turn input
functions.behaviour: Selects whether explicitly entered turns go to the chosen draft phase or are applied to the puzzle.
entry_points: button G1 input row: Turns to > draft / live
button Solve: Turns to > draft / live
functions.notes: Changing the destination itself does not execute a turn.

functions.name: Derive Cleanup from Prepare
functions.behaviour: Sets Cleanup to the inverse of the explicitly chosen Prepare recipe.

functions.name: Check the complete operation
functions.behaviour: Checks the entire Prepare / Macro / Cleanup draft against the current state, goal and protection and opens its operation controls.

functions.name: Read the operation findings
functions.behaviour: Opens the check result with the endpoint goal, full protection findings, strict-prefix evidence and computed reasons.
entry_points: button G1 protection strip: Check results
button Solve Macros: complete-operation effect readout

functions.name: Inspect computed operation reasons
functions.behaviour: Locates the first object in the chosen computed reason and highlights all its evidence in the Hub; a reason without objects opens the findings instead.
entry_points: button Solve Protection: Reason 1 / Reason 2 / Reason 3
functions.notes: Reason inspection uses the complete operation cycle scope and requires the displayed recommendation to match the current work.

functions.name: Locate a protected-position conflict
functions.behaviour: Lists endpoint and strict-prefix position conflicts from the current review and inspects the explicitly selected fixed position.
entry_points: button Conflicting protected positions: Activate selected entry
key Conflicting protected positions list: Enter / double-click selected entry

functions.name: Stage the reviewed operation
functions.behaviour: Stages exactly the operation identified by the current review, leaving execution as a separate action.
entry_points: key focused operation Review / Preview / Execute / Cancel button: Control+Enter

functions.name: Execute the staged operation
functions.behaviour: Executes the explicitly staged operation through the engine and adopts the accepted authoritative result.
entry_points: key focused operation Review / Preview / Execute / Cancel button: Control+Shift+Enter
functions.notes: The UI does not substitute a hover or draft forecast for a staged execution. State, revision and protection validity are enforced by the engine dependency.

functions.name: Cancel the staged preview
functions.behaviour: Cancels the staged preview while retaining the operation draft.
entry_points: button G1 operation strip: Cancel preview

functions.name: Stop an active analysis
functions.behaviour: Requests cancellation of the current analysis job; an unacknowledged stop keeps inputs blocked until the outcome is known.
entry_points: button G1 operation strip: Stop check
button Solve operation footer: Stop check
button Macro details Compare: Stop check
button Save inverse macro / Save macro with R: Stop check
button Map a macro to another frame: Stop check
button New solve / Reset puzzle / Reset workspace: Stop check
button Import session log: Stop check
functions.notes: Cancellation does not queue another command; the shell waits for the job and finalizer acknowledgment.

functions.name: Undo a committed operation
functions.behaviour: Asks the engine to undo the committed operation and refreshes actual state and work readouts.

functions.name: Redo an undone operation
functions.behaviour: Asks the engine to redo a committed operation and refreshes actual state and work readouts.

functions.name: Focus or hide operation controls
functions.behaviour: Opens the shared Solve window and focuses Review or New operation, or hides the operation region and returns focus to graphical work.
functions.notes: In G2 the legacy macro and operation window IDs are aliases of one Solve window; opening, hiding and moving it participate in layout persistence.

functions.name: Open the Solve subsections
functions.behaviour: Opens the Macros, Prepare or Protection subsection of the shared Solve window.

functions.name: Inspect fixed solving roles
functions.behaviour: Inspects the explicitly assigned A, B or Target position without changing Current.

functions.name: Inspect an operation boundary
functions.behaviour: Shows Actual or independently simulated pieces after Prepare, Macro or Cleanup; an executed operation requires a new or reused draft for non-Actual inspection.
entry_points: button Hub phase strip: After Prepare
button Hub phase strip: After Macro
button Hub phase strip: After Cleanup
functions.notes: These are read-only boundary forecasts, not a staged preview or execution permission.

functions.name: Compare actual and predicted objects
functions.behaviour: Toggles the Hub's exact after overlay for the checked complete operation; unavailable, stale or executed predictions cannot be used as a new result.
entry_points: button Hub: Show after overlay / Hide after overlay

functions.name: Show the selected macro body effect
functions.behaviour: Shows the selected macro's fixed action, refreshing its bound effect if necessary.

functions.name: Show the full operation effect
functions.behaviour: Selects the complete operation effect readout and Hub effect display.

functions.name: Find and activate a keyboard bank
functions.behaviour: Searches available banks by exact ID, orbit or purpose, shows their actual caps and macro slots, and activates the explicitly selected bank.

functions.behaviour: Selects the next or previous available bank in its declared default cycle.

functions.behaviour: Opens or hides the keyboard with effective command, Grip and Twist meanings, current work context and focus ownership.
functions.notes: G2 uses a separately owned floating window whose placement and visibility are saved.

entry_points: button G1 input row: hold / latch (Grip mode drop-down)

functions.name: Select or release an explicit Grip
functions.behaviour: Selects one effective cap using a physical Grip key or an onscreen Grip button; a second click releases an onscreen Grip. Hold/latch mode and simultaneous-key rejection control the physical selection.

entry_points: button G1 workspace header: Solve actions

button G2 linked view tabs: Actual Global

functions.name: Hide all supporting windows

functions.behaviour: Zooms Local or Global with explicit in/out commands or the mouse wheel, bounded to the view's supported range.
entry_points: button Local / Global canvas: mouse wheel

functions.behaviour: Returns the Local or Global camera orientation and zoom to its defaults.

functions.notes: This command names a synthetic example, not evidence of a human solve.

functions.name: Open Macro Base
functions.behaviour: Opens the existing macro catalogue, in G1's inline region or the Macros subsection of G2's Solve window.
entry_points: button G1 workspace header: Macro Base

functions.name: Leave Macro Base
functions.behaviour: Closes the catalogue and returns to graphical work without inserting a macro.
entry_points: key G1 Macro Base search: Escape
key G2 Macro Base search / macro list: Escape

functions.name: Search existing macros
functions.behaviour: Filters displayed macro names and records as the catalogue search text changes; a hidden selection is not silently replaced.
entry_points: button G1 / G2 Macro Base: search text

functions.name: Choose and inspect an existing macro
functions.behaviour: Selecting an existing catalogue entry or a bank's first or second macro slot checks its exact effect and stores the explicit selection without inserting it.
entry_points: button G1 / G2 Macro Base: select library entry

functions.name: Filter macros by likely solving use
functions.behaviour: Filters the visible catalogue to all uses, the current orbit, another explicit orbit, Other or Not checked using stored checked-effect classifications.
entry_points: button Solve Macros catalogue: Likely solving use (drop-down)
functions.notes: The displayed likely-use classification is an inference and does not select or execute a macro.

functions.name: Check library effects in bounded batches
functions.behaviour: Checks up to seventy-two existing macro effects for exact action and use classification, reporting how many remain.
entry_points: button Solve Macros catalogue: Check library

functions.name: Compose macro catalogue facets
functions.behaviour: Selects checked action type, affected orbit, all required tags, pin status and likely use, then explicitly applies the validated local catalogue filter.
entry_points: button Filter Macro Base: Macro exact action type (drop-down)
button Filter Macro Base: Actual affected orbit (drop-down)
button Filter Macro Base: Pinned entries only (check box)
button Filter Macro Base: Likely solving use filter (drop-down)
button Filter Macro Base: Apply filter

functions.name: Clear pending macro facets
functions.behaviour: Clears the filter editor's pending facets; the user applies the result separately.
entry_points: button Filter Macro Base: Clear facets

functions.name: Edit macro labels and notes
functions.behaviour: Edits the selected macro's name, notes, comma-separated tags and pin, then saves metadata while retaining its fixed recipe and revision. With no selection it offers import or explicit creation.
entry_points: button Edit macro · <name>: Pinned in Macro Base (check box)
button Macro library: Activate selected entry
key Macro library list: Enter / double-click selected entry

functions.name: Pin or unpin a macro
functions.behaviour: Toggles the selected macro's pin metadata.

functions.name: Export a fixed macro
functions.behaviour: Exports the explicitly selected macro's canonical recipe and identity to a local JSON library file using atomic file replacement.
entry_points: button Export selected fixed macro file picker: Save

functions.name: Inspect a macro library import
functions.behaviour: Reads a bounded local library file and displays new, identical and conflicting entries before adding anything.
entry_points: window Inspect a macro library file
button Inspect a macro library file picker: Open
button Import macros · <filename>: select comparison record

functions.name: Add inspected new macros
functions.behaviour: Explicitly adds the inspected new canonical identities as a complete import; conflicts block the import, identical local metadata is kept and imported proof claims are ignored.
entry_points: button Import macros · <filename>: Add <count> new macros

functions.name: Append a macro to the active phase
functions.behaviour: Appends the explicitly selected fixed macro recipe to the active phase; the retained catalogue selection alone never inserts it.
entry_points: button G1 Macro Base: Append macro
button Solve Macros: Add / Add to <phase>
key G2 Macro Base macro list: Enter

functions.name: Replace the active phase with a macro
functions.behaviour: Replaces the active phase recipe with the explicitly selected fixed macro.

functions.name: Create an explicit finite macro
functions.behaviour: Saves a user-entered name, concrete finite recipe and purpose or notes as a macro.
entry_points: window Save a finite user-selected macro
button Save a finite user-selected macro: Apply explicitly

functions.name: Read a macro's details
functions.behaviour: Shows the selected revision's effect, current body applicability, use-score reasons, fixed recipe and canonical record in a read-only dialog.
entry_points: button Solve Macros: selected macro body effect readout

functions.name: Compare two saved macros
functions.behaviour: Chooses a second saved macro and checks whole-action equality, inverse equality and affected-position facts for the exact bound revisions.
entry_points: button Macro details Compare: Second macro to compare (drop-down)
button Macro details Compare: Check comparison
functions.notes: Pair comparison is read-only and cannot certify intermediate protection of a complete operation.

functions.name: Save an inverse macro
functions.behaviour: Creates a separately named inverse of the selected exact macro revision and reports its checked relationship to the source.
entry_points: button Save inverse macro: Save inverse
functions.notes: Saving and selecting the derived macro are separate; the source and draft stay in place.

functions.name: Save a macro with explicit R
functions.behaviour: Creates a separately named variant with the explicit chronological word R inverse, Macro, R, after checking that the source revision and displayed R are still current.
entry_points: button Macro details: Save with R…
button Save macro with R: Save with R
key Save macro with R: Enter

functions.name: Select a saved derived macro
functions.behaviour: Explicitly selects and inspects the successfully saved inverse, R or geometry variant after checking its current revision, without adding it to a phase.
entry_points: button Save inverse macro: Select saved macro
button Save macro with R: Select saved macro
button Map a macro to another frame: Select saved macro

functions.name: Choose a macro's geometric reference frames
functions.behaviour: Opens the geometric variant editor and loads all twelve proper ordered frames for each explicitly selected source and destination cell.
entry_points: window Map a macro to another frame
button Map a macro to another frame: Geometry source cell (drop-down)
button Map a macro to another frame: Geometry destination cell (drop-down)
button Map a macro to another frame: Geometry source frame (drop-down)
button Map a macro to another frame: Geometry destination frame (drop-down)
button Map a macro to another frame: Load frames

functions.name: Use the selected Grip as a geometric destination
functions.behaviour: Copies the cap and ordered frame that were active when the geometric editor opened into its destination reference, after checking the opening bank and frame still match.
entry_points: button Map a macro to another frame: Use selected Grip

functions.name: Check a geometric macro mapping
functions.behaviour: Checks the full-label correspondence and emitted legal recipe for the selected source revision and explicit frame pair; changing the pair invalidates the result.
entry_points: button Map a macro to another frame: Check reference
key Map a macro to another frame: Enter

functions.name: Save a checked geometric macro
functions.behaviour: Saves the checked mapping as a separately named macro and verifies its returned recipe and reference proof before enabling explicit selection.
entry_points: button Map a macro to another frame: Save new macro

functions.name: Compare visible macros in current work
functions.behaviour: Checks at most twelve visible existing macros with the current Prepare and Cleanup fixed, showing direct benefit, possible preparation, protection blockage or missing evidence and ordering only the checked batch.
entry_points: button Solve Macros: Compare current use
functions.notes: Results do not select a macro or change the operation.

functions.name: Show explicit known endgame families
functions.behaviour: Expands or collapses the known-operation panel inside Solve Macros.

functions.name: Choose a known operation family
functions.behaviour: Selects explicit placement-star, orientation transfer at X/B, orientation transfer at A/B or last-buffer-B commutator parameters and invalidates any earlier check.
entry_points: button Solve Macros Endgame: Known operation family > Place · A → B → X
button Solve Macros Endgame: Known operation family > Transfer orientation · X / B
button Solve Macros Endgame: Known operation family > Transfer orientation · A / B
button Solve Macros Endgame: Known operation family > Last buffer B · commutator
button Solve Macros Endgame: Known operation family > Choose operation

functions.name: Assign explicit endgame auxiliaries
functions.behaviour: Uses the actual inspected fixed position as X or Y and loads its legal fixed-slot element choices for the working orbit.
entry_points: button Solve Macros Endgame: Use inspected as X
button Solve Macros Endgame: Use inspected as Y
functions.notes: These are editor parameters, not reassignments of Current, Next, target or fixed work buffers.

functions.name: Choose endgame fixed-slot elements
functions.behaviour: Focuses the q or r selector and lets the user choose a displayed legal permutation of its explicit ordered slots, invalidating the earlier proof.
entry_points: button Solve Macros Endgame: q · slot frame
button Solve Macros Endgame: r · slot frame
button Solve Macros Endgame: Explicit q permutation of the fixed ordered slots (drop-down)
button Solve Macros Endgame: Explicit r permutation of the fixed ordered slots (drop-down)

functions.name: Check an explicitly entered endgame
functions.behaviour: Checks the complete legal recipe and full collateral effect for the chosen family, auxiliaries and slot elements, and displays its bound result.
entry_points: button Solve Macros Endgame: Check effect

functions.name: Save a checked endgame macro
functions.behaviour: Saves the exact checked parameters under a user-entered macro name, keeping the returned proof and revision for later explicit selection.
entry_points: button Solve Macros Endgame: Save macro
functions.notes: Saving does not insert or execute the operation.

functions.name: Select a saved endgame macro
functions.behaviour: Selects and inspects the saved endgame macro after checking its bound revision.
entry_points: button Solve Macros Endgame: Select saved

functions.name: Read the endgame effect and proof
functions.behaviour: Shows the explicit family mapping, retained buffer roles, q/r slot orders, complete collateral list and recipe/proof record.
entry_points: button Known endgame effect tabs: Effect
button Known endgame effect tabs: Recipe and proof

functions.name: Read current residuals
functions.behaviour: Shows the actual nonbuffer and buffer position and Home-orientation errors, frame availability, necessary invariants and exact completion checks for the current bound state.

functions.name: Read the last committed solver delta
functions.behaviour: Shows the journal receipt's before/after position and orientation counts, protected damage and compact list of changed fixed positions.

functions.name: Locate a position changed in the last step
functions.behaviour: Inspects an explicitly selected changed position from the last-step receipt, after checking that the journal head has not changed.
entry_points: button Last committed step: Locate position

functions.name: Choose a following unfinished orbit
functions.behaviour: Lists the last exact-completion suggestions and switches only to the orbit explicitly chosen by the user.
entry_points: window Last completion suggestions · inspect and choose
button Last completion suggestions · inspect and choose: Activate selected entry
key Last completion suggestions · inspect and choose list: Enter / double-click selected entry

functions.name: Choose Current, Operation or After cycle inspection
functions.behaviour: Selects actual identity-to-Home relationships, the chosen operation's action or the independent after-Cleanup residual view.
functions.notes: Ownership and residual arrows are inspection data, not executable moves.

functions.name: Choose a cycle effect scope
functions.behaviour: Inspects the selected saved macro, composed Macro steps or the complete operation in the shared cycle display.
entry_points: button Hub displayed effect scope: Selected macro / Macro steps / All steps

functions.name: Choose a cycle inspection orbit
functions.behaviour: Selects Working orbit or an explicit orbit for operation-cycle inspection without changing the working orbit.
entry_points: button Hub cycle overview: Cycle inspection orbit (drop-down)

functions.name: Select an exact cycle or orientation position
functions.behaviour: Chooses a canonical anchor from the current cycle index or a Cycle, Frame or Position ring button and requests its exact detail.
entry_points: button Hub: Inspect an exact directed macro cycle (drop-down)
button Hub cycle ring: Cycle <display number>
button Hub cycle ring: Frame <display number>
button Hub cycle ring: Position <display number>
functions.notes: Display numbering is not an object ID; each item carries its canonical fixed-position anchor. The source also retains a cached macro-cycle fallback.

functions.name: Navigate cycle ring focus
functions.behaviour: Moves keyboard focus to the neighboring ring button and scrolls the focused ring into view.
entry_points: key Hub cycle ring buttons: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight

functions.name: Refresh cycle inspection
functions.behaviour: Reloads the currently chosen exact cycle view.

functions.name: Page the cycle and orientation indexes
functions.behaviour: Advances both available cycle/orientation indexes or returns to the previous recorded index page.

functions.name: Page the selected cycle's edges
functions.behaviour: Shows the next returned edge segment or the previous segment in the selected canonical cycle.

functions.name: Inspect a directed cycle edge
functions.behaviour: Selects an effect arrow or advances to the next displayed edge with Enter, then opens its exact ordered source-to-destination slot correspondence.
entry_points: button Hub cycle canvas: click a directed effect arrow

functions.name: Show or hide entry slot correspondence
functions.behaviour: Toggles the exact macro-entry or selected-edge correspondence readout, showing source and destination slots rather than executing a turn.
entry_points: menu Hub object actions: Entry slots
key Hub object menu: E mnemonic for Entry slots

functions.name: Read cycle slot and identity details
functions.behaviour: Hovering the correspondence graphic shows the full source/destination identity details or an exact source-to-destination slot pair and transported label.
entry_points: button Hub entry correspondence graphic: hover source identity / destination identity / slot pair

functions.name: Read or refresh Session
functions.behaviour: Opens the authoritative session report with source, journal head, timer and scramble/solution/operation counts, or refreshes its current report.

functions.name: Resume saved work
functions.behaviour: Resumes the saved work without resetting its state.

functions.name: Start a new solved session
functions.behaviour: Shows the new-session scope and explicitly starts solved with a new timer attempt, cleared work and a checkpoint retaining previous progress.

functions.name: Reset the puzzle recoverably
functions.behaviour: Shows the puzzle-reset scope and explicitly returns labels to Home with a recovery checkpoint while retaining view preferences, key sets and macros.
functions.notes: The reset dialog distinguishes this action from a completed solve.

functions.name: Reset work presentation
functions.behaviour: Explicitly clears Current, Next, steps and work presentation while keeping the puzzle, journal, personal key sets and macros.

functions.name: Reset puzzle and structural views
functions.behaviour: Restores retained puzzle camera/projection/size defaults and Local/Global cameras while retaining puzzle state, work and history.

functions.name: Stage a recorded legal scramble
functions.behaviour: Chooses 100, 1000 or a custom 1–10000 legal turns and an explicit or generated recorded seed, then stages the scramble in Prepare. Existing steps or preview require explicit replacement consent and execution remains separate.
entry_points: button Stage scramble: Scramble size > Short · 100 turns / Full · 1000 turns / Custom
button Stage scramble: Scramble length (numeric input)
button Stage scramble: Replace current steps and pending preview (check box)
button Stage scramble: Stage in Prepare

functions.name: Start or pause the session timer
functions.behaviour: Starts or pauses the explicit session timer.
functions.notes: The action carries command=start or command=pause; it does not issue puzzle turns.

functions.name: Save the verified session log
functions.behaviour: Asks the engine to save the current C600 log in its managed session-log location and reports the resulting filename.

functions.name: Inspect a saved session log
functions.behaviour: Chooses a bounded local C600 JSON/compressed or MPUlt log, checks its explicit format and displays the engine's verified replay receipt and recovery scope.
entry_points: window Inspect a saved session log
button Inspect a saved session log file picker: Open
button Import session log: Log format > C600 proof log · compressed or JSON / MPUlt native log
button Import session log: Check file

functions.behaviour: Applies the checked local log using its confirmation ID and requires an authoritative import receipt; the displayed scope includes a journal branch and recovery checkpoint while retaining current preferences and work.
entry_points: button Import session log: Import log

functions.name: Export a verified session log
functions.behaviour: Exports a C600 compressed proof log or MPUlt log to an explicitly selected local file after checking returned bytes and SHA-256 against the engine receipt.
entry_points: button Export session log file picker: Save

functions.name: Read recorded whole-model completion
functions.behaviour: Displays the recorded completion predicate, source, counts and timer in Solve summary, and can reopen that saved result without issuing turns.

functions.notes: An eligible committed completion can open the same window once its matching receipt is acknowledged. Reopening a summary is not a new completion or a claim of a human solve.

entry_points: button main native workspace window frame: Close
key active owned native form: Alt+F4

functions.name: Resize the linked graphical area
functions.behaviour: Dragging the defined splitter changes the allocation between the Hub and its linked native view region.
entry_points: button G1 graphical workspace: splitter drag
button G2 linked graphical workspace: splitter drag

button Help · Magic 600 Cell shared readouts: hover Current / Next / protection

internal_only.name: ExperimentSendOutcome.Worker / Finalize
internal_only.reason: Internal send/finalization logic retains accepted commit/import receipts across refresh or renderer failures; it has no independent user entry point.

internal_only.name: Full native mapping, geometry and renderer lifecycle
internal_only.reason: Internal mapping/configuration and snapshot adoption preserve the immutable full model and control readiness. The visible startup, display and input actions are inventoried separately.

internal_only.name: HTTP client calls rather than HTTP route definitions
internal_only.reason: This shard defines native clients, not HTTP handlers. Their routes are listed as engine_call/depends_on; no other shard's route is claimed as an entry point here.

internal_only.name: Input window watches, focus epochs, IME ownership and scan-code conversion
internal_only.reason: These are input-router guards and low-level physical code decoding, not additional command bindings. Text/modal/capture ownership, repeat suppression and held-key reset support the declared commands, Grips and Twists.

internal_only.name: Binding validation, merge and protected convenience defaults
internal_only.reason: Internal validation, bank/shared merge and copy logic support the binding editors. Rejected Enter, Windows/meta and window-management chords are not actionable bindings.

internal_only.name: button Keyboard: unbound physical keys (— / Close / Next / Accept)
internal_only.reason: Unmapped physical-key placeholders are disabled; their descriptive captions do not implement onscreen Close/Next/Accept commands. Mapped command, Grip and Twist buttons are listed under their functional dispatch surfaces.

internal_only.name: button Keyboard: Functions shortcuts (<count>) heading
internal_only.reason: The Functions heading is disabled because its combinations are always shown. The clickable Extra keys heading in other sets is inventoried.

internal_only.name: button Hub: Choose an existing macro for this work (browseMacro)
internal_only.reason: The button has a macro-search callback but LayoutSceneCore always hides it. Reachable Macro Base commands and controls are inventoried elsewhere.

internal_only.name: key Local / Global legacy camera fallback: Home, Add, Oemplus, Subtract, OemMinus, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown
internal_only.reason: The connected experiment sets RegistryCameraInput=true on both views, bypassing this direct fallback; camera commands and mouse gestures remain reachable.

internal_only.name: NativeCellView.LocalHops / CaptureCamera / GripHighlightsRegion
internal_only.reason: Internal configuration/getters used by rendering or fixtures; this shard has no user control for selecting a one/two-hop neighborhood.

internal_only.name: label Puzzle display: Instant turns · committed result, without a turn animation
internal_only.reason: A read-only label reports current behavior; it is not a turn-speed or animation toggle.

internal_only.name: Historical macro / operation work-window IDs
internal_only.reason: Compatibility aliases and restored layout records resolve to the shared Solve window; they do not create independent current Macro or Operation windows.

internal_only.name: Phase/cycle snapshot provenance and stale-result withdrawal
internal_only.reason: Internal serial, model, hash, revision, frame/filter and source-selection guards withdraw or reject obsolete inspection data; explicit inspection controls are listed separately.

internal_only.name: Macro/candidate/recommendation/endgame proof binding and captions
internal_only.reason: Internal revision-bound validation and presentation determine whether displayed facts remain current; user checks, selectors and saves are inventoried.

internal_only.name: NativeCellGeometry / NativeCellStatus / Hub painting and measured layout
internal_only.reason: Internal geometry parsing, projection, color/status aggregation, hit data, drawing and layout have no separate entry point beyond the view, inspection and camera controls.

internal_only.name: ExperimentWindowPlacement.Clamp / Place and minimized-window restoration
internal_only.reason: Pure placement policy and OS window restoration support owned-window opening; there is no placement command or model-state action.

internal_only.name: Private native/input/send/hub timing and diagnostics
internal_only.reason: Internal optional diagnostics and timing hooks have no normal user-facing command or window. Diagnostic output is not performance or Windows verification evidence.

internal_only.name: Shared ToolDialog, styles, fields, menus and picker ownership
internal_only.reason: Internal UI construction and input ownership helpers implement the concrete editors and dialogs already inventoried.
